STEP 5 - Energy: Feta-type cheese is about 260 kcal/100 g. Cured sausage is about 450 kcal/100 g.

Totals: about 163 g, roughly 0.45 × 150 + ... ≈ 420 kcal for the cheese plus about 60 kcal for the sausage, so about 480 kcal overall.
